svg.title: A Chat Client in a Few Lines
svg.desc: Your code gets a DefaultAzureCredential from azure-identity, which uses Microsoft Entra ID through az login or the VM's managed identity, with no API key. AIProjectClient from azure-ai-projects connects to the Foundry project through the project endpoint. get_openai_client returns a client that calls the model. responses.create sends the input with model set to the deployment name, for example support-chat, not the model family. The deployment's reply is read from output_text. Each request stands alone, so resend history or use a conversation.
svg.text: A Chat Client in a Few Lines
Authenticate, connect to the project, call the deployment by name, read output_text.
Entra ID: az login, or the VM's managed identity; no API key
A client that calls the model by deployment name
model = the deployment name, not the model family
The reply. Each request stands alone: resend history or use a
